purpose: Teach: 劣っ/裏返し/裏腹/正しかっ/小柄/可愛らしい/起っ/つくれ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、他店に劣っているわけじゃないと自信を持とうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, don't doubt yourself. We're not falling behind the other locations.
lines.style: Soft, encouraging opening. Reaches across the counter with her eyes. Steady, warm conviction — not pep talk, but quiet belief. Voice settles on the reassurance.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、エプロンが裏返しになっちゃってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Your apron was inside out earlier, by the way.
lines.style: Light, affectionate observation. Slight smile in the voice — not mocking, just noticing something small and human. Delivered with the ease of someone who doesn't make a big deal of small things.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、見た目と裏腹に気さくな方ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer earlier — looks serious but turned out to be really friendly, didn't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost to herself. Noticing something true about people. Gentle pause before the observation lands. The voice of someone who sees past first impressions.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、結局、新メニューの判断が正しかったね、メイちゃん
lines.en: In the end, you were right about that new menu item.
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction. Slight emphasis on 「right」 — not triumphant, just honest. The tone of someone confirming what was already suspected but now proven.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新スタッフは小柄だけど力持ちね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The new hire's small but surprisingly strong, isn't she?
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment. Admiring without fanfare. Voice rises slightly on the observation, then settles with approval. Genuine respect in the delivery.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様のお子様が可愛らしい笑顔でいらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Did you see that customer's child smiling so brightly when they came in?
lines.style: Soft, delighted. The voice of someone noticing something good and wanting to mark it. Warm rise on 「smiling,」 then gentle fadeout. Present-tense wonder.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店の前で行列が起ってきたね、メイちゃん
lines.en: There's a line forming out front now.
lines.style: Pleased observation, almost surprised. Slight lift in energy — not excited, but noting something good is happening. Quiet pride in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、特別な思い出をお客様につくれるお店にしようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Let's make sure this becomes the kind of place where customers take special memories home with them.
lines.style: Firm, gentle direction. Opening with intention. Slower pace — this matters. Voice settles into something purposeful. The tone of someone setting a quiet north star.
